motion.scroll: Lenis on wheel, native touch, C1-continuous handoffs with frame-rate-independent rAF damping
motion.guide: Continuous 4-chapter travelling phone weaving through center Swipe Guide, three stacking riso Field Notes folios (Right -> Left -> Center with split display type), and right-docked Android Edition

must: Follow the system reduced-motion preference (upright 0deg, no pinning or 3D tilt).
Represent the four swipe decisions and APK availability accurately.
Match boundary scroll velocities (C1 continuity) and damp pose changes so travelling elements never hit an abrupt stop or snap between states.
Keep surrounding copy minimal (less is more): bold headline plus one short sentence per chapter, using wordless visual specimens instead of repeating UI details.
avoid: Hard boolean screen flips during scroll transitions or easing to a static Y right before entering 1:1 document scroll.
Duplicate eyelines, status pills, tickets, or text lists that repeat what the in-phone UI or chapter spine already shows.
Generic arrow/tab carousels or repeating the same pinned-stage mechanic across consecutive sections.

decisions.decision: Use oversized Dela heads, layered photographic prints, Lenis wheel smoothing and a reversible four-direction swipe demonstration. Provide direct controls and reduced-motion layouts.
